title: Sukhothai Historical Park
summary: Sukhothai was the capital of the first Siamese kingdom, in the 13th and 14th centuries by UNESCO's account. ICOMOS lists the monastery Wat Mahathat and the two stupas of Wat Sra Si among its principal monuments, and a 70 square kilometre historic park was declared there in 1988.

uncertainty.note: UNESCO's summary says the 13th and 14th centuries; its description says the 13th and 15th centuries, so the end may run to 1500.

where.modern_name: Sukhothai Historical Park, Sukhothai Province, Thailand
where.historical_name: Sukhothai, capital of the first Kingdom of Siam

importance.justification: UNESCO World Heritage Site (1991): capital of the first Kingdom of Siam and a masterpiece of the first Siamese architectural style per ICOMOS.
